caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric, possibly a quilt or textile, rendered in shades of gray pencil. The fabric is decorated with stitched or embossed patterns, primarily featuring birds and floral motifs. There are three prominent birds in various flying positions spread across the surface, surrounded by clusters of flowers and leafy vines. The bird in the center is the largest and faces downward with its wings extended. The left and right edges of the fabric each feature another bird, both with wings open and surrounded by similar floral decorations. The background consists of a regular grid or crosshatch pattern that fills the entire textile. The drawing is detailed and focuses on the texture and stitched appearance of the designs on the fabric. The entire textile object is positioned horizontally, with one edge slightly turned over. The color of the drawing is monochromatic, utilizing grayscale pencil on an off-white or light-colored paper.
